description: bin/lib/contact-email.ts contactEmail() is the one resolver of the polite-pool contact email (D-19-09): it reads the variable named by [network] contact_email_env (default PENSMITH_CONTACT_EMAIL), honours a configured name only when it is in pensmith's own namespace — an upper-case PENSMITH_ identifier containing EMAIL or MAILTO and no secret word (PASSWORD, PASSWD, SECRET, TOKEN, KEY, URL, URI, DSN, AUTH, CREDENTIAL) — because a paper's config travels with the paper and must not aim pensmith at a secret or another personal variable, and sends a value only when it is a plain address. A second reader of process.env.PENSMITH_CONTACT_EMAIL or of the config's contact_email_env would ignore the configured variable or skip those checks. http.ts's User-Agent, the OpenAlex / Unpaywall / retraction-lookup parameters and the doctor probe all call contactEmail().
